name: How often should I have my gutters cleaned in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How often should I have my gutters cleaned in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Bay Area, especially in areas with many trees like parts of Pacifica or Millbrae, it's recommended to have your gutters cleaned at least twice a year. A thorough cleaning in late fall after most leaves have fallen is crucial to prevent winter clogs. An additional cleaning in late spring can address debris from blooming trees and prepare for potential summer rains. More frequent cleaning might be needed if your property is surrounded by dense foliage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gutters in the Bay Area should be cleaned at least twice a year, especially in late fall and late spring, more if surrounded by dense trees.
